criteria.statement: vocoder init's existing-and-valid-key reuse path clearly states the key is being reused and was verified, not just "configured" — distinguishable from the fresh-generation path's wording

evidence.ref: this PR's diff to packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts — session.step("API key", highlight("Configured")) changed to session.step("API key", highlight("Existing key verified")), inside the branch that only runs after getAppConfig() has successfully verified the key against the real API. The fresh-generation path's own wording ("Generated API key" / "API key saved to X") is unchanged, so the two remain visually distinct.

criteria.statement: No behavior change — the same conditions that generate a fresh key or reuse an existing one today produce the same outcome after this fix, only the messaging differs

evidence.ref: this PR's diff touches exactly one string literal on one line; no branching, no new condition, no call added or removed. packages/cli/src/__tests__/init.test.ts's existing reuse-branch tests assert on return codes and downstream mock calls (mockRunProjectCreate, mockInstallForProject, mockWriteGitHubActionsWorkflow), never on the literal session.step copy, so none needed modification — confirmed via git diff showing no test file changes.
